title: How to Watch CPL 2026: TV Channels and Live Streaming
description: Complete CPL 2026 TV and streaming guide for the Caribbean, United States and Canada, with providers, devices, match times and country-by-country rights status.
headline: CPL 2026 live streaming and TV channels
lede: Rush Live & Louder will show CPL 2026 across the Caribbean, while Willow lists the tournament for viewers in the United States and Canada. Check the service available in your country before the first match on 7 August.

status.access: Linear television through major regional cable and TV networks
status.note: CPL says the channel will carry comprehensive coverage of the 2026 season from 7 August. Provider channel numbers and packages vary by territory.

status.access: Willow TV, willow.tv, mobile apps and participating TV providers
status.note: Willow lists Caribbean Premier League 2026 from 7 August to 20 September and identifies CPL among its covered T20 leagues.

status.note: Willow describes its service as a cricket broadcaster for the United States and Canada. Confirm the individual match listing before paying.

north_america.heading: How to watch CPL 2026 on Willow
north_america.intro: Willow lists the complete 39-match CPL 2026 season for viewers in the United States and Canada. Check the individual fixture in Willow's schedule before subscribing.

routes.title: Stream on the Willow website or apps
routes.text: Subscribers can watch through willow.tv and Willow by Cricbuzz apps on supported phones, tablets and connected televisions.

routes.title: Use a participating US TV provider
routes.text: Willow lists DISH, Sling, Verizon Fios, Spectrum, Xfinity, Optimum, DIRECTV, DIRECTV Stream, Fubo and YouTube TV among its United States television routes. Package access varies.

routes.title: Check the digital stream during clashes
routes.text: When several matches overlap, Willow may place another event on Willow Extra or its website and apps. Registered subscribers should check the live schedule for the correct stream.

steps.title: Start with your territory
steps.text: Broadcast rights follow location. Use the Caribbean or North America route only if your viewing location falls inside that service area.

steps.title: Find the match in the schedule
steps.text: A channel partnership is not enough. Open the provider guide and confirm the exact fixture, start time and channel before you subscribe.

steps.title: Check access on your device
steps.text: Sign in early, update the app and test playback before first ball. TV-provider access and direct streaming subscriptions can use different login routes.

faq.question: Where can I watch CPL 2026 live in the Caribbean?
faq.answer: Rush Live & Louder is the confirmed Caribbean television home for the men's and women's CPL in 2026. CPL says it is available through major cable and television networks across the region. Ask your provider for the channel number and package.

faq.question: Where can I watch CPL 2026 in the USA?
faq.answer: Willow by Cricbuzz lists Caribbean Premier League 2026 in its schedule. Viewers can use Willow TV, willow.tv, supported apps or a participating television provider, subject to subscription and match availability.

faq.question: Is CPL 2026 available in Canada?
faq.answer: Willow serves both the United States and Canada and lists the 2026 CPL tournament. Canadian viewers should confirm the current plan and the individual fixture in Willow's schedule.

faq.question: Can I watch CPL 2026 free on YouTube?
faq.answer: CPL has not announced a free worldwide YouTube stream for the 2026 season. Highlights may appear on CPL channels, but they do not include full live-match coverage.

faq.question: Who will show CPL 2026 in India?
faq.answer: CPL has not announced its 2026 broadcaster for India. Check the CPL schedule and local sports listings before subscribing to a service.

faq.question: Are CPL fixture times shown in my local time?
faq.answer: The official CPL fixture announcement lists each start in the local time of the host venue. Most host territories use UTC-4, while Jamaica uses UTC-5.

faq.question: Can I watch Willow while travelling outside the USA or Canada?
faq.answer: Willow states that its service is available only in the United States and Canada. Rights and access can change when you travel.

faq.question: Will replays and highlights be available?
faq.answer: Rush Live & Louder says its schedule includes live matches, highlights and other cricket programming. Willow advertises live streams, match replays and highlights for subscribers, subject to rights and availability.

faq.question: How many devices can use one Willow subscription?
faq.answer: Willow says subscribers can access premium content on up to two devices at the same time. App-store purchases must be linked to the same Willow account before access is restored on another device.

faq.question: What should I do if a CPL match is not on the main Willow TV channel?
faq.answer: Check Willow's live streaming schedule. When events overlap, another match may appear on Willow Extra, willow.tv or the Willow by Cricbuzz apps for registered subscribers.

faq.question: How do I find Rush Live & Louder in my Caribbean territory?
faq.answer: Use the official Rush Caribbean Where to Watch directory to find the television provider currently listed for your territory. Channel numbers, packages and availability are controlled by the local provider and can change.
